source_snapshot.test_name_items: Set LAN source in static via BIOS
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Set LAN source by:
    - Boot into setup menu and move to the BMC networking page.
    - Set the source to "Static" then change the settings.
          Type IP address in the column of "IPv4 address".
          Type netmask in the column of "Subnet mask".
          Type default gateway IP address in the column of "Default Gateway".
2. Boot into OS
3. Send command: ipmitool lan print to check LAN information.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC LAN should display correctly as setting.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this path sets the LAN source to static (typing IPv4 address + subnet mask) in the BIOS setup BMC-networking page, then saves & exits. Typing fields in BIOS setup menus is interactive Pre-OS work the agent cannot drive over SSH/ipmitool.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator sets the BMC networking page to Static, types the IPv4 address + subnet mask in BIOS setup, saves & exits, boots to OS; agent could afterwards confirm via `ipmitool lan print`.

original_test_intent: Verify BIOS can configure and persist the BMC static IPv4 address, mask and gateway, with correct post-boot read-back and connectivity.
original_method: An engineer enters values in pre-OS BIOS setup, saves/reboots and then verifies through IPMI.
manual_activity: Interactive BIOS entry/save is the function under test and must be engineer-operated; the agent can only perform post-boot read-only validation.
safety_requirements: Preflight address uniqueness and preserve prior config.
Do not automate unverified BIOS keystrokes.
Maintain alternate recovery when BMC address changes.
No automatic retry; restore approved mode.
agent_execution_scope: After engineer configuration, read LAN state, test reachability/persistence and correlate MAC/identity.
Do not operate BIOS or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Enter/save BIOS values, reconnect and restore.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote substitution; lan print remains a post-check only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep manual BIOS method with secure read-only verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS static IP/mask/gateway, boot, lan print and 10/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record prior state and BIOS entry/save, reconnect by mapped MAC/new address, verify all fields and persistence, then restore if required.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conflict preflight, identity and rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not replace the BIOS control path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong static values can strand management access.

project_override_considerations: Use approved project addresses and report exact executed plan; do not expose secrets.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria align; project-specific network values are inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is clear and manually executable; manual BIOS core is not BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds identity and recovery without substituting IPMI writes.

review_improvement: Ensures the BIOS path receives credit and disruptive readdressing remains recoverable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A later IPMI read proves resulting state but not BIOS field entry/save behavior, so the interactive pre-OS operation remains the core manual acceptance.
